items.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Supportive. When we’re in Europe, he wants me to play with him.

ctx.x: Was he supportive of you or was he fearful of you?
Supportive. When we’re in Europe, he wants me to play with him. Especially if he ain’t getting the audience. “C’mon up here girl.”
Do you think that event in 1940, was it an audition?
